text_en: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all their multitude.
text_cn: 这样，天地和天地间的一切点缀都完成了。

text_en: And on the seventh day God finished the work that he had done, and he rested on the seventh day from all the work that he had done.
text_cn: 到第七天天主造物的工程已完成，就在第七天休息，停止了所作的一切工程。

text_en: So God blessed the seventh day and hallowed it, because on it God rested from all the work that he had done in creation.
text_cn: 天主祝福了第七天，定为圣日，因为这一天，天主停止了他所行的一切创造工作。

text_en: These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created. In the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
text_cn: 这是创造天地的来历：在上主天主创造天地时，

text_en: when no plant of the field was yet in the earth and no herb of the field had yet sprung up—for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was no one to till the ground;
text_cn: 地上还没有灌木，田间也没有生出蔬菜，因为上主天主还没有使雨降在地上，也没有人耕种土地，

text_en: but a stream would rise from the earth, and water the whole face of the ground—
text_cn: 有从地下涌出的水浸润所有地面。

text_en: then the Lord God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and the man became a living being.
text_cn: 上主天主用地上的灰土形成了人，在他鼻孔内吹了一口生气，人就成了一个有灵的生物。

text_en: And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden, in the east; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
text_cn: 上主天主在伊甸东部种植了一个乐园，就将他形成的人安置在里面。

text_en: Out of the ground the Lord God made to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight and good for food, the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
text_cn: 上主天主使地面生出各种好看好吃的果树，生命树和知善恶树在乐园中央。

text_en: A river flows out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it divides and becomes four branches.
text_cn: 有一条河由伊甸流出灌溉乐园，由那里分为四支：

text_en: The name of the first is Pishon; it is the one that flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
text_cn: 第一支名叫丕雄，环流产金的哈威拉全境；

text_en: and the gold of that land is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there.
text_cn: 那地方的金子很好，那里还产珍珠和玛瑙；

text_en: The name of the second river is Gihon; it is the one that flows around the whole land of Cush.
text_cn: 第二支河名叫基红，环流雇士全境；

text_en: The name of the third river is Tigris, which flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
text_cn: 第三支河名叫底格里斯，流入亚述东部；第四支河即幼发拉的。

text_en: The Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to till it and keep it.
text_cn: 上主天主将人安置在伊甸的乐园内，叫他耕种，看守乐园。

text_en: And the Lord God commanded the man, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
text_cn: 上主天主给人下令说：“乐园中各树上的果子，你都可吃，

text_en: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall die. ”
text_cn: 只有知善恶树上的果子你不可吃，因为那一天你吃了，必定要死。”

text_en: Then the Lord God said, “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper as his partner. ”
text_cn: 上主天主说：“人单独不好，我要给他造个与他相称的助手。”

text_en: So out of the ground the Lord God formed every animal of the field and every bird of the air, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them; and whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.
text_cn: 上主天主用尘土造了各种野兽和天空中的各种飞鸟，都引到人面前，看他怎样起名；凡人给生物起的名字，就成了那生物的名字。

text_en: The man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the air, and to every animal of the field; but for the man there was not found a helper as his partner.
text_cn: 人遂给各种畜牲、天空中的各种飞鸟和各种野兽起了名字；但他没有找着一个与自己相称的助手。

text_en: So the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; then he took one of his ribs and closed up its place with flesh.
text_cn: 上主天主遂使人熟睡，当他睡着了，就取出了他的一根肋骨，再用肉补满原处。

text_en: And the rib that the Lord God had taken from the man he made into a woman and brought her to the man.
text_cn: 然后上主天主用那由人取来的肋骨，形成了一个女人，引她到人前，

text_en: Then the man said, “This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; this one shall be called Woman, for out of Man this one was taken. ”
text_cn: 人遂说：“这才真是我的骨中之骨，肉中之肉，她应称为‘女人’，因为是由男人取出的。”

text_en: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and they become one flesh.
text_cn: 为此人应离开自己的父母，依附自己的妻子，二人成为一体。

text_en: And the man and his wife were both naked, and were not ashamed.
text_cn: 当时，男女二人都赤身露体，并不害羞。
